Hi Alicia —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation, I put together a draft Mutual Action Agreement (attached) that lays out the evaluation timeline, success criteria, and the concrete acceptance tests your team proposed. High-level items:

- 4-week pilot starting June 14 (week-by-week milestones in the sheet)
- Success criteria: 90th percentile latency <= 800ms on 2k daily requests; average cost per 1k responses within target band; >= 85% fidelity on the provided test set.
- Exit gates: performance (latency/cost), quality (concordance with ground truth), and security checklist completion (SOC2 evidence + network review).
- Verification artifacts: test-case runbook (attached PDF), smoke harness results, and a signed acceptance note.

Two asks from your side to finalize the MAP:
1) Confirm the evaluation KPIs above or propose edits by EOD Thursday (June 10).
2) Share procurement contact + preferred contracting cadence so we can align pricing and DocuSign steps.

Attaching: Curepath_MAP_v1.xlsx, evaluation-test-cases.pdf.

I looped in Ben (AE) for commercial alignment. Priyom will join for the technical kickoff on day 0.

Best,

Hi Alicia / Mike / procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for flagging the contingency week. Attached is an updated MAP (Curepath_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a short evaluation verification packet (evaluation-test-cases.pdf) that reflects:

- Timeline updated to a 5-week pilot window with week 5 as a contingency.
- Quality threshold changed to 80% concordance per request.
- Acceptance criteria:
  * Functional: smoke harness run with >=95% pass on critical flows daily during week 4.
  * Quality: final concordance >=80% on the canonical test set; we will provide the concordance report and the raw scored outputs as artifacts.
  * Performance: 90th percentile latency <=800ms under agreed load profile.
  * Security: SOC2 snapshot + data handling checklist completed pre-kickoff.

- Exit gates (no-go conditions):
  * If any single category (quality, performance, security) fails twice in a row during week 4, we pause and run a joint debugging sprint.
  * If the debugging sprint does not remediate the failure within 5 business days, either party may terminate evaluation without penalty.

Next steps:
1) Procurement: send standard MSA + short SOW referencing the MAP so we can sign the evaluation order form.
2) Alicia: confirm acceptance of the attached files by Friday (June 11) so we can schedule the June 14 kickoff.
3) Priyom: join the kickoff and run the staging smoke test; Camila will share the access instructions beforehand.

If procurement prefers, we can send the SOW via DocuSign. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/4892

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
